description: Which title, channel or fixture is this name? Give a file name, a release name or a playlist entry ("Top.Gun.Maverick.2022.1080p.mkv", "US: ESPN2 HD"); it is cleaned (year, season and episode, quality tags, playlist decorations) and matched by similarity. A matchup ("NFL: Chiefs vs Bills", "Lakers @ Celtics", "Rangers at Celtic 19:45") is answered by the fixture whose two teams those are, kicking off between 36 hours ago and 7 days ahead unless date narrows it. Each result carries a score in 0..1. Use screen for films and TV, channels for television channels, sports for fixtures.

bbox.description: west,south,east,north; west > east crosses the antimeridian

collection.description: Collection slug: screen, channels or sports (optional), e.g. screen

date.description: A day (YYYY-MM-DD) to look for a fixture on, plus a day either side, e.g. 2026-11-02

kind.description: Item kind: title, channel or fixture (optional), e.g. title

limit.description: Rows to return, integer 1-50, default 5, e.g. 3

q.description: The name as written, e.g. Top.Gun.Maverick.2022.1080p.mkv or US: ESPN2 HD

sort.description: Result order. distance (needs lat and long) puts the nearest first, e.g. "distance"; anything else keeps newest first

year.description: A four-digit year to prefer, when known, e.g. 2022

name: match_items
